name: llm-wiki
description: Installs and maintains a per-repo codebase knowledge base (.llm-wiki/) so AI coding agents orient fast and use fewer tokens. Tuned for Python, Node.js, T-SQL/SQL Server (sqlproj, SQL scripts, SSIS), PostgreSQL (psql script repos) and R (renv, packages, targets, Quarto, Shiny) repos, plus Slurm/HPC batch jobs. Ships an always-on maintainer skill plus /llm-wiki:init, :update, :lint, :upgrade and :view commands — :view builds a human-only HTML review dashboard from the Markdown canon, and :upgrade retrofits a wiki made by an older version to the current structural contract. A second, independently-triggering data-sources skill recognizes key external data sources in any repo — relational and warehouse engines, object stores and network shares, embedded files, caches/queues/streams, and named APIs/SFTP — recording reusable connection shape in a user-global catalog and repo-specific usage in an optional .llm-wiki/data-sources.md page, never a secret. Generates pointer files for Claude, Codex/AGENTS.md, and GitHub Copilot.
